questions.explanation: Half times 12 times 9 equals 54. Forgetting the half gives 108, double the true value.

questions.subject: MICROECONOMICS
questions.learningObjective: Compute profit from surplus and fixed cost
questions.stem: A transit planner's board sees producer surplus 260 and fixed cost 190; what is economic profit?
questions.explanation: Profit is 260 minus 190, which equals 70. Adding fixed cost would give 450, the wrong direction.

questions.subject: MICROECONOMICS
questions.learningObjective: Explain shutdown in terms of variable cost
questions.stem: Explain why a firm shuts down when price is below average variable cost.

answer.exemplar: When price is below average variable cost, each unit loses money on variable costs, so stopping limits loss to fixed costs.

questions.explanation: Operating below variable cost deepens losses beyond fixed costs. The wrong view says fixed costs drive the shutdown.
